description: Evolvulus bahamensis is endemic to the Lucayan Archipelago occurring in the central and southern islands. It was originally considered only on the Turks and Caicos Islands but herbarium specimens have been observed from throughout the southern Bahamas. Correll and Correll (1982) treat this as a variant of the Greater Antilles species E. arbuscula Poir but recent work considers it distinct (Acevedo and strong 2012) as its own species.
creator: Ethan Freid
